visibility-controls.justification: The derived plugin already ships the Display Conditions engine, UI, AND/OR groups and element cache handling; Element Pack rules are registered into it instead of adding a parallel repeater.

condition_mappings.date: current_date (native, two rules joined with AND)
condition_mappings.time_range: time_of_the_day (native, two rules joined with AND)
condition_mappings.country: digitalisimo_country (site filter, CDN/server headers, browser timezone cookie, then cached IP lookup compatible with element_pack_visibility_* filters)
condition_mappings.visit_count: legacy adapter only: reads and, when headers are still open, updates the bdt-visit-count-{element} cookie like Element Pack; no native condition
condition_mappings.session_count: legacy adapter only: reads the stored session counter without starting PHP sessions or incrementing it; no native condition

visibility-controls.status: 28 native conditions since 4.3.0.81 (16 only with WooCommerce); since 4.3.0.82 existing Element Pack documents keep identical visibility without the plugin (multisite A/B with Element Pack 9.9.1 matched in every scenario, also after an editor save); optional conversion to native Display Conditions pending
visibility-controls.legacy_adapter: modules/digitalisimo-conditions/class-legacy-visibility.php + class-legacy-rules.php: reads ep_display_conditions_enable/_to/_relation and the ep_display_conditions repeater with Element Pack 9.9.1 semantics for all 46 rule keys; same control names and defaults; inactive while Element Pack is loaded; honours element_pack_elementor_extend[visibility-controls]; no _elementor_data rewrite
